svg.text: Eleven Azure services, one identity, one command to deploy. Numbers follow a match through the cloud pipeline.

One user-assigned managed identity: roles for Blob, Queue, Table, Cosmos data, registry pull and SignalR. No keys in code or image.
FOLLOW ONE MATCH THROUGH THE CLOUD PIPELINE
serves the app; the page asks the Brain to start a match
the page starts a match, polls the feed, asks questions (REST)
the Brain calls the Foundry agents to write and verify stories
verified text is shared: the next viewer's identical moment is instant
the job writes 5 s tracking chunks into Blob Storage
each new chunk raises a BlobCreated event
Event Grid wakes the analyze Function
events in Cosmos DB wake interpret, then dispatch (change feed)
dispatch asks the Brain for the story of each new moment
push sends each stored overlay through SignalR to the page
